title: Welcome

need.title: Ask for what you are missing.
need.text: Big or small. Someone will turn up.
need.example: Beach volleyball partners, a car pool, more drinking water in the neighbourhood.

offer.title: Offer what you can.
offer.example: Repairing bikes, space in your yard for a party, piano lessons for vegetables.

connect.title: Connect with everyone who wants the same.
connect.text: Together you agree on goals. Your vote stays secret.
connect.example: Start a band, push for a bike lane, found a solar cooperative.

placeText: This decides what we suggest and where your vote counts as affected. You can read and discuss everywhere.
placeNote: We only store your municipality and neighbourhood, never your address.
appearanceTitle: How do you want to appear?
appearanceText: You are verified either way. You decide what others see. You can change it later.

real.title: Real name
real.text: Your name appears on posts and in groups.

alias.title: Pseudonym
alias.text: A pseudonym marked “verified”. Nobody sees who is behind it.

interestsTitle: What do you need? What can you offer?
interestsText: Tap what fits or add your own. You can be more specific later.
ageOk: I am at least 16 years old.
ageHint: Under 18 you are better protected: strangers can only reach you through shared groups.
